reviews.suggested_text: Blessed are you, O Lord, great King and mighty in your greatness, Lord of all heavenly creation[a], King of kings and God of all the world. Your sovereign power[b], your kingdom, and your greatness endure forever and ever, and your authority endures through every generation. All the heavens are your throne forever, and the whole earth is the footstool of your feet forever and ever.[c]
